WHAT WE LEARNT

Short, honest lessons

  • The wins: Harry’s Yacht, Bella Verona and Sulek made the saved top pick count.
  • The near misses: Veyepee, Semantics, De Armas and Bev’s Nine still finished in the money.
  • The Oaks: Proxima Dea beat the De Armas selection; the saved top three still contained the winner.
  • The finish: Rey Magnerio won R9; Bev’s Nine ran third. R9 remained interim when this roundup was published.
